positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience
positions.description:
- Designed and built an LLM-powered deployment diagnostics system that synthesizes Jenkins, GitHub,
and Splunk telemetry to identify evidence-backed root causes of failed deployments, significantly reducing
production incident investigation time. 

- Led an initiative to expand automated integration testing across decentralized repositories by developing AI-assisted tooling that enabled service owners to bootstrap standardized test infrastructure with minimal manual effort.

- Mailchimp Deployment Service Expert: Acted as an SME for Mailchimp's deployment service, ensuring the seamless, continuous deployment of hundreds of product changes daily. Led real-time troubleshooting in ArgoCD and Kubernetes during production rollouts across multiple namespaces, ensuring smooth operational stability. 

- Monolith Application Modernization & Optimization: Worked towards the modernization and support of Mailchimp's PHP-based monolith application, handling everything from debugging new releases and major PHP version upgrades to ensuring the test suite runs effectively.
Compiled Mailchimp’s application container image from PHP’s upstream source code, creating ARM-native development images that resulted in a 70% performance increase in developer environments, benefiting over 600 developers. Navigated upstream PHP bugs and minor revision change when compiling from source for production as well.

- Rearchitected Monolith Deployments: Led the redesign of Mailchimp's deployment process, migrating from a legacy data center solution to a modern Jenkins service in Kubernetes (EKS). The transformation involved extensive containerization and performance tuning, resulting in improved deployment monitoring, enhanced resilience, and a more efficient deployment process for developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Developer Experience
positions.description:
Engineer on a team designing and implementing developer experience tooling and infrastructure with an in-house development environment.
- Converted a Docker Compose based development environment to Kubernetes in an ongoing effort to reduce developer toil with local environments
- Assessed multiple paths towards a remote development environment leveraging GCP GKE with different architectures to support application development and deployment needs
- Architected and implemented a preliminary remote development environment that considers technical requirements and cost optimization to avoid waste and reduce resource consumption
- Developed a modular and extendable Golang CLI for developers to interact with local environments and replace legacy Python and Bash scripts, providing consistent and thorough functionality
- Worked to improve feature-based incident resolution time from 20 minutes to 15 seconds by implementing a Golang based feature flag observer
- Increased stability of the Mailchimp development environment by upgrading from MySQL 5.7 to 8 and patching various stagnant home-grown dependencies as a result, including database schema migration tool

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Lead and teach 30+ students each week in a classroom setting
- Create, proof, and grade exam questions
- Worked on a team to redesign an automated grader for homework submissions
- Tutored students in a one-on-one style environment to provide individualized guidance 
- Held 3 office hours a week to assist students with coursework and concepts

positions.title: Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Re-designed a CLI tool for creating Google Cloud projects that interface with the local Kubernetes infrastructure using Golang to reduce overhead for engineers. 
- Utilizes Cobra as a framework for future CLI addition and Terraform to create a base infrastructure for projects. 
- Created CI testing for new changes to Golang code – Runs on Jenkins and builds a container image for each release to ensure stable functionality. 
- Added unit table tests with native Golang testing package for future conversion to test driven development. 
- Added to an internal data center manager that touches every piece of local infrastructure via CLI, UI, and API.

positions.title: Cloud Automation Intern
positions.description:
- Architected and implemented an autonomous VM template lifecycle management system for production use reducing delivery time from weeks to minutes including patching and testing. 
- Leveraged Packer, Docker, and vRealize Automation to develop a solution that integrates with vSphere to efficiently transfer large templates across production data centers utilizing minimal bandwidth. 
- Integrated Serverspec unit tests and Active Directory joins to ensure VM templates are valid after latest applied patches before deploying to production data centers. 
- Utilized GitLab for CI/CD testing to quickly prototype a PoC of the proposed solution. 
- Presented solution to an IT Review Board for overall review of design and production pilot approval before moving into production use.  
- Created a virtual cluster of hypervisors for development to simulate physical hardware requirements. 
- Produced architectural documentation including BRD, FRD, Paper Analysis, and Runbook
